answer: Peers cross-check attestations against a public ledger that acts as a mirror, so fake duplicates are flagged. Each agent stakes a bond tied to a verifiable hardware key; new identities must pass a costly proof-of-work challenge nicknamed falcon, where spawning N sybils costs N times the compute and stake. Any fable of free identities collapses once attackers must burn real capital per node, making mass fakery economically irrational. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
